reason: The previously published UN Comtrade HS2 values do not reconcile with the same provider's totals: Ghana 2023 HS2 exports summed to $67.5B, while a UN Comtrade TOTAL query with matched dimensions (partner World, second partner World, all customs procedures, all transport modes) returned $16.8B. The old extractor and loader did not keep or filter those breakdown dimensions, which is a suspected cause; the exact cause is unconfirmed because no raw Comtrade snapshot survives. No product values or shares are published until a matched re-extraction is validated.
revalidation: Re-extract with extraction/extract/comtrade_extract.py (pins partner2=0, customs=C00, mot=0).
Load with scripts/load_comtrade_silver.py (rejects unpinned slices and duplicate keys).
Reconcile each reporter-year HS2 sum to UN Comtrade TOTAL with identical dimensions; use IMF IMTS only as a cross-source warning.
